page.layout: One printed page (left-hand page of an opening). Running head at top left and page number/book reference at top centre; main text in a central column; a bracketed sub-list ("Significabat / Generaliter / Specialiter", "Sunt / Per Synecd.dictum tabernaculum / Atrium") set beside the text with braces; no marginal notes in the left margin; the right-hand page is a fragment of the facing page showing only edge text, not transcribed.

main_text.p: tota stylobatis nixis ad reliqua fustentenda.
Generaliter ecclesia visibile ministerij respectu esse columnam veritatis. 1.Tim.3.17.
Specialiter, munera, officia, & membra in ecclesia, varia esse, totius corporis sustentacula, donorum facultatum, actionumq; dignitate discrepantia. Prou.9.1. Gal.2.9. Apoc.3.12. ἀναλογῶς.
Interna, erant instrumenta omnia ad cultum dei ex praeced.

Significabant autem, omnia varia, pretiosa, sancta instrumentorum in ecclesia, (qualia sunt, verbum, sacramenta, dona varia) ita varia, preciosa, sancta, speciali ex dei institutione esse, Zach. 14.20.21.
Tabernaculum erat, in quo res sacrae à personis sacris perficiebatur. Ex praeced.
Significabat eam ecclesiæ partem, quæ ex viuis in Christo membris constabat. Apocal. 11.2. ἀναλογῶς.
Erat autem decem aulæorum è xylino natiuo internexo, & hyacintho, & purpureo, & coccinneo dibatho, (Cherubinis intextis) opere artificiosissimo confectorum. Exo.26.1.
Cherubini, angelos ecclesiæ & Christo inseruientes significabant. Esa.6.

page.notes: Partly illegible in places: the bracketed sub-list items are reconstructed from the braces; the "ἀναλογῶς" Greek word is printed as ἀναλογῶς in the scan (rendered approximately). Right-hand page is a partial facing page and not transcribed. Several words near the gutter and the sidenote fragments of the right page are unreadable.
